subject: Retention surcharge mitigation & dashboard bundle — pricing checklist
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Retention surcharge / dashboard bundle question

Jordan —

Thanks for the demo last week. We like Redwood's tracing and the advanced dashboard prototypes, but before we lock a commitment we need clarity on two items that will materially affect our model:

1) Retention surcharges: our ingestion spiked in April due to a reporting change and we got flagged for a retention surcharge. Can you confirm how you calculate the surcharge (per-GB/month vs percentage), and whether there's a cap during the first 3–6 months post-commit?

2) Dashboard bundling: we'd like to include the advanced dashboards (seatless, cross-project views) as an add-on. Can you give an example bundle price for ~1TB/month retention, 100k traces/day, and a 12-month term? Any concession paths for a pilot or a PO-to-contract timeline?

Attached is a stripped-down usage CSV for May to help you model (Acme-Usage-Report-May2028.csv). Looking to close timing by early June.

Appreciate a short checklist we can share with procurement.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Analytics
Acme Health

--
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention surcharge / dashboard bundle question

Alice —

Thanks for the usage file — helpful. Quick checklist and what we can offer to move this forward:

• Surcharge model: default is a per-GB/month surcharge after your committed retention threshold. Typical unit: $0.08/GB-month for warm retention, $0.025/GB-month for cold archival. We also support a percentage-based cap if you prefer (e.g., surcharge capped at 20% of baseline observability spend).

• Short-term mitigation: we can grandfather current surcharge rates for 90 days post-signing and provide a one-time usage credit to cover the April spike (we generally do this for pilot customers).

• Dashboard bundle: for your profile (~1TB/mo retention + 100k traces/day) we can offer a bundled rate of $9k/month for advanced dashboards (includes cross-project dashboards, two exported report templates, and priority ingest sampling tuning). That's a ~25% discount off list for a 12-month commit.

• Pilot concession: 3 months of dashboard access at a 50% discount + $15k in credits to offset initial retention overages. If you convert to a 12-month paid term, credits are applied to the first invoice.

I've attached a draft SKU playbook with line items and an example invoice so procurement can see the math (Redwood-Observability-SKU-Draft-20280530.pdf).

Next steps: if that looks reasonable I'll loop finance and legal to put a short SOW/DocuSign and route a PO. If procurement needs an example invoice with breakpoints (cold/warm/archival), Marissa can add the calc.

Would you be available for a 20–30 minute call Thursday to walk the numbers?

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

--
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 31 May 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Retention surcharge / dashboard bundle question

Looping in pricing details and a conservative concession path for procurement. Jordan — feel free to copy the bolded lines below into the proposal.

Proposal (conservative):

• Baseline units: 1 TB warm retention / month; 100k traces/day.
• List surcharge (warm): $0.08/GB-month; archival $0.025/GB-month.
• Concession path for April spike: one-time credit equal to the excess over baseline for the first 2 months (capped at $10k).
• Pilot package: 3 months dashboards at 50% off + $15k retention credit (applied if they sign a 12-month term within 60 days).
• Surcharge cap: while on a qualifying 12-month term we can cap surcharges at 20% of monthly observability spend for the first 6 months. After month 6, standard surcharges apply unless renegotiated.

Sample invoice line (monthly):
- Observability base (commit): $28,000
- Advanced dashboards (bundle): $9,000 (discounted)
- Retention surcharge (if >commit): $0–$6,000 (capped at 20%)

I've attached a quick price calc sheet that models three scenarios (continued baseline, April spike sustained, and archival shift) — Price-Calc-ACME-Scenario.xlsx. Jordan, if Procurement pushes for a longer grandfathering period we can consider 6 months but would need approval from Finance.

Also recommend adding a trial clause: pilot access + credits, with a conversion clause that specifies credits become non-refundable on conversion. That simplifies revenue recognition.

If Alice confirms the pilot we can send a short SOW + DocuSign link tomorrow.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Pricing
Redwood Inference

Jordan / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear checklist. The conservative proposal looks acceptable to Procurement as a starting point: the 3-month pilot + $15k credit and the 90-day grandfathering on surcharge rates are workable. We do prefer the 6-month surcharge cap if you can get Finance sign-off, but we can start with 6 months as a negotiation ask rather than a blocker.

Please send the SOW/DocuSign and an example PO so Procurement can route internally. Proposed kickoff: week of 6/10 if paperwork completes.

Attached: PO-Intent-Acme.pdf (non-binding)

Thanks,
